import json, signal, sys
from urllib.parse import urlparse, parse_qs
from selenium import webdriver
from selenium.webdriver.chrome.service import Service
from selenium.webdriver.common.by import By
from selenium.webdriver.common.keys import Keys
from selenium.webdriver.common.action_chains import ActionChains
from selenium.webdriver.support.ui import WebDriverWait, Select
from selenium.webdriver.support import expected_conditions as EC
s = json.loads(sys.argv[1]); driver = None
signal.signal(signal.SIGALRM, lambda *args: (_ for _ in ()).throw(TimeoutError('Filter browser exceeded 25 seconds'))); signal.alarm(25)
try:
    options = webdriver.ChromeOptions(); options.binary_location = '/usr/bin/chromium'
    options.set_capability('goog:loggingPrefs', {'browser': 'ALL'})
    for flag in ['--headless=new', '--no-sandbox', '--disable-dev-shm-usage', '--window-size=1440,1200']: options.add_argument(flag)
    driver = webdriver.Chrome(service=Service('/usr/bin/chromedriver'), options=options); driver.set_page_load_timeout(8); wait = WebDriverWait(driver, 6)
    driver.get(s['url']); name, value = s['cookie'].split('=', 1); driver.add_cookie({'name': name, 'value': value, 'path': '/'})
    # Installed before app bootstrap: createApi captures this fetch function. Holds retain actual HTTP response bytes.
    driver.execute_cdp_cmd('Page.addScriptToEvaluateOnNewDocument', {'source': """
      window.__nativeFetch = fetch.bind(window); window.__requests = []; window.__held = []; window.__events = [];
      const snapshot = () => {const form = document.querySelector('.filter-form'); return form ? {valid: form.checkValidity(), fields: [...form.elements].map(el => ({tag: el.tagName, type: el.type, value: el.value, valid: el.validity?.valid, rect: el.getBoundingClientRect().toJSON()}))} : null;};
      for (const type of ['pointerdown', 'pointerup', 'click', 'submit', 'invalid']) document.addEventListener(type, event => window.__events.push({type, target: event.target.outerHTML?.slice(0, 200), form: type === 'submit' || type === 'click' ? snapshot() : null}), true);
      window.__formSnapshot = snapshot;
      window.fetch = (url, options = {}) => {
        const path = new URL(url, location.href).pathname, method = options.method || 'GET';
        const entry = {url: String(url), path, method, body: options.body, hasSignal: Boolean(options.signal)};
        window.__requests.push(entry);
        const hold = window.__hold && window.__hold.path === path && window.__hold.method === method;
        if (hold) window.__hold = null;
        return window.__nativeFetch(url, options).then(async response => {
          entry.status = response.status;
          if (!hold) return response;
          const bytes = await response.arrayBuffer();
          return new Promise(resolve => window.__held.push({path, method, release: () => resolve(new Response(bytes, {status: response.status, headers: response.headers}))}));
        });
      };
    """})
    def visit(path):
        driver.execute_script('location.hash=arguments[0]', path)
    def button(text, parent=None):
        xpath = './/button[normalize-space()="' + text + '"]' if parent else '//main//button[normalize-space()="' + text + '"]'
        return wait.until(lambda d: (parent or d).find_element(By.XPATH, xpath) if (parent or d).find_element(By.XPATH, xpath).is_enabled() else False)
    def text(): return driver.find_element(By.TAG_NAME, 'body').text
    def write(selector, value):
        field = wait.until(EC.element_to_be_clickable((By.CSS_SELECTOR, selector))); field.send_keys(Keys.CONTROL, 'a', Keys.NULL, Keys.BACKSPACE); field.send_keys(value); return field
    def form_name(): return driver.find_element(By.CSS_SELECTOR, '.filter-form input').get_attribute('value')
    def api(method, path, body=None):
        return driver.execute_async_script("const [method,path,body,done]=arguments;window.__nativeFetch('/api/v1'+path,{method,headers:{'content-type':'application/json','X-Crew-Request':'1'},body:body==null?undefined:JSON.stringify(body)}).then(async r=>done({status:r.status,data:await r.json()})).catch(e=>done({error:e.message}))", method, path, body)
    def card(name): return wait.until(EC.presence_of_element_located((By.XPATH, '//ul[@class="saved-filters"]/li[.//h2/a[normalize-space()="' + name + '"]]')))
    def hold(method, filter_id, suffix=''):
        driver.execute_script('window.__hold={method:arguments[0],path:arguments[1]};window.__held=[]', method, '/api/v1/filters' + ('/' + filter_id if filter_id else '') + suffix)
    def held(): wait.until(lambda d: d.execute_script('return window.__held.length') == 1)
    def release(): driver.execute_async_script('const done=arguments[0];window.__held.splice(0).forEach(item=>item.release());requestAnimationFrame(()=>requestAnimationFrame(done))')
    def select_org(org):
        picker = driver.find_element(By.XPATH, '//fieldset[legend[normalize-space()="Organization"]]')
        Select(picker.find_element(By.TAG_NAME, 'select')).select_by_value(org)
    source_id = s['source']['id']; other_id = s['other']['id']; source_path = '/filters/' + source_id
    driver.get(s['url'] + '/?filter-proof=' + s['mode'] + '#/filters?orgId=' + s['orgId'])
    card('Source filter')
    if s['mode'] == 'resource':
        # The list still carries revision 1/query priority>=4; actual Run must read revision 2/query Resource.
        assert api('PATCH', source_path, {'query': 'Resource', 'expectedRevision': 1})['status'] == 200
        card('Source filter').find_element(By.LINK_TEXT, 'Run filter').click()
        wait.until(lambda d: '30 issues found' in text())
        assert driver.find_element(By.CSS_SELECTOR, '[aria-label="Saved query"]').text == 'Resource'
        assert 'saved revision 2' in text() and len(driver.find_elements(By.CSS_SELECTOR, '.search-results li')) == 25
        section = driver.find_element(By.CSS_SELECTOR, 'section[aria-label="Search results"]')
        button('Next', section).click(); wait.until(lambda d: 'Page 2' in section.text)
        assert len(section.find_elements(By.CSS_SELECTOR, '.search-results li')) == 5
        requests = driver.execute_script('return window.__requests.filter(item=>item.path.endsWith("/search"))')
        assert len(requests) == 2 and all(item['path'] == '/api/v1' + source_path + '/search' for item in requests)
        assert parse_qs(urlparse(requests[1]['url']).query).get('cursor') and all(item['hasSignal'] for item in requests)
        assert not driver.find_elements(By.CSS_SELECTOR, '.search-results script') and not driver.execute_script('return Boolean(window.filterInjected)')
        button('Previous', section).click(); wait.until(lambda d: 'Page 1' in section.text)
        # A full direct link loads the canonical resource without a preceding list.
        driver.get(s['url'] + '/?direct-filter=1#' + source_path)
        button('Create personal copy').click(); wait.until(lambda d: form_name() == 'Source filter copy')
        write('.filter-form input', 'Deliberate personal copy')
        Select(driver.find_element(By.CSS_SELECTOR, '.filter-form select')).select_by_value('personal')
        button('Save filter').click(); wait.until(lambda d: d.find_element(By.TAG_NAME, 'h1').text == 'Deliberate personal copy')
        copied_id = driver.current_url.split('#/filters/')[1]
        copied = api('GET', '/filters/' + copied_id)['data']['filter']; original = api('GET', source_path)['data']['filter']
        assert copied['id'] != source_id and copied['visibility'] == 'personal' and copied['query'] == 'Resource'
        assert original['name'] == 'Source filter' and original['revision'] == 2
        button('Edit saved filter').click(); write('[aria-label="Saved filter query"]', 'priority>=4'); button('Save filter').click()
        wait.until(lambda d: 'Saved “Deliberate personal copy”.' in text())
        assert api('GET', '/filters/' + copied_id)['data']['filter']['revision'] == 2
        button('Create personal copy').click(); write('.filter-form input', 'Deliberate personal copy'); button('Save filter').click()
        wait.until(lambda d: 'Choose a distinct name' in text()); assert form_name() == 'Deliberate personal copy'
        print(json.dumps({'ok': True, 'mode': s['mode'], 'currentQuery': True, 'directLink': True, 'opaquePages': requests, 'copy': copied['id'], 'sourceRevision': original['revision'], 'duplicateName': True, 'safeHighlights': True}))
    elif s['mode'] == 'custody':
        # Two out-of-order record reads: only the selected second record may own the editor.
        hold('GET', source_id); button('Edit', card('Source filter')).click(); held()
        button('Edit', card('Other filter')).click(); wait.until(lambda d: form_name() == 'Other filter'); release(); assert form_name() == 'Other filter'
        write('.filter-form input', 'Declined replacement'); button('Create saved filter').click(); wait.until(EC.alert_is_present()).dismiss(); assert form_name() == 'Declined replacement'
        button('Create saved filter').click(); wait.until(EC.alert_is_present()).accept(); wait.until(lambda d: form_name() == '')
        write('.filter-form input', 'Published held create')
        wait.until(lambda d: form_name() == 'Published held create' and '11 suggestions available' in d.find_element(By.CSS_SELECTOR, '.filter-form').text and d.execute_script('return document.querySelector(".filter-form").checkValidity()'))
        driver.execute_script('window.__beforeDoubleClick=window.__formSnapshot()'); hold('POST', '')
        ActionChains(driver).double_click(button('Save filter')).perform(); held()
        posts = driver.execute_script('return window.__requests.filter(item=>item.method==="POST"&&item.path==="/api/v1/filters")')
        assert len(posts) == 1 and posts[0]['hasSignal'] and posts[0]['status'] == 201
        select_org(s['otherOrgId']); wait.until(EC.alert_is_present()).dismiss(); assert form_name() == 'Published held create'
        select_org(s['otherOrgId']); wait.until(EC.alert_is_present()).accept(); card('Second organization filter')
        button('Create saved filter').click(); write('.filter-form input', 'Replacement org editor'); release()
        assert form_name() == 'Replacement org editor' and 'Saved “Published held create”.' not in text()
        assert len(api('GET', '/filters?orgId=' + s['orgId'] + '&q=Published')['data']['items']) == 1
        button('Cancel').click(); wait.until(EC.alert_is_present()).accept()
        select_org(s['orgId']); card('Source filter')
        hold('DELETE', source_id); button('Delete', card('Source filter')).click(); wait.until(EC.alert_is_present()).accept(); held()
        select_org(s['otherOrgId']); card('Second organization filter'); release()
        assert 'Deleted “Source filter”.' not in text() and not driver.find_elements(By.LINK_TEXT, 'Source filter')
        assert api('GET', source_path)['status'] == 404
        print(json.dumps({'ok': True, 'mode': s['mode'], 'outOfOrderReads': True, 'doubleSubmitCount': len(posts), 'publishedAbandonedCreate': True, 'changedOrg': True, 'abandonedDelete': True, 'dirtyDeclineAndConfirm': True}))
    else:
        button('Edit', card('Source filter')).click(); write('.filter-form input', 'My name'); write('.filter-form textarea', 'My description')
        assert api('PATCH', source_path, {'name': 'Peer name', 'description': 'Peer description', 'query': 'priority>=3', 'expectedRevision': 1})['status'] == 200
        button('Save filter').click(); button('Inspect latest saved version').click()
        wait.until(EC.presence_of_element_located((By.CSS_SELECTOR, 'aside[aria-label="Latest saved filter"]')))
        aside = driver.find_element(By.CSS_SELECTOR, 'aside[aria-label="Latest saved filter"]')
        assert 'Source filter' in aside.text and 'My name' in aside.text and 'Peer name' in aside.text
        apply = driver.find_element(By.XPATH, '//button[normalize-space()="Apply selected field choices"]'); assert not apply.is_enabled()
        driver.find_element(By.XPATH, '//label[normalize-space()="Use mine for Name"]/input').click(); assert not apply.is_enabled()
        driver.find_element(By.XPATH, '//label[normalize-space()="Use latest for Description"]/input').click(); button('Apply selected field choices').click()
        assert form_name() == 'My name' and driver.find_element(By.CSS_SELECTOR, '.filter-form textarea').get_attribute('value') == 'Peer description'
        assert driver.find_element(By.CSS_SELECTOR, '[aria-label="Saved filter query"]').get_attribute('value') == 'priority>=3'
        assert api('GET', source_path)['data']['filter']['name'] == 'Peer name'
        assert api('PATCH', source_path, {'query': 'priority>=2', 'expectedRevision': 2})['status'] == 200
        button('Save filter').click(); button('Inspect latest saved version').click(); button('Keep my changes on latest version').click(); button('Save filter').click()
        wait.until(lambda d: 'Saved “My name”.' in text())
        saved = api('GET', source_path)['data']['filter']; assert saved['revision'] == 4 and saved['name'] == 'My name' and saved['query'] == 'priority>=2' and saved['description'] == 'Peer description'
        button('Edit', card('My name')).click(); write('.filter-form input', 'Retained before replacement')
        button('Cancel').click(); wait.until(EC.alert_is_present()).dismiss(); assert form_name() == 'Retained before replacement'
        assert api('PATCH', source_path, {'name': 'Fifth revision', 'expectedRevision': 4})['status'] == 200
        button('Save filter').click(); hold('GET', source_id); button('Inspect latest saved version').click(); held()
        button('Edit', card('Other filter')).click(); wait.until(EC.alert_is_present()).accept(); wait.until(lambda d: form_name() == 'Other filter'); release()
        assert form_name() == 'Other filter' and not driver.find_elements(By.CSS_SELECTOR, 'aside[aria-label="Latest saved filter"]')
        write('.filter-form input', 'Retained inaccessible draft'); assert api('DELETE', '/filters/' + other_id)['status'] == 200
        button('Save filter').click(); wait.until(lambda d: 'no longer editable with your current access' in text())
        assert form_name() == 'Retained inaccessible draft' and not driver.find_element(By.CSS_SELECTOR, '.filter-form input').is_enabled()
        assert not driver.find_element(By.XPATH, '//button[normalize-space()="Save filter"]').is_enabled()
        wait.until(lambda d: not d.find_elements(By.LINK_TEXT, 'Other filter'))
        print(json.dumps({'ok': True, 'mode': s['mode'], 'perFieldChoices': True, 'independentMerge': True, 'separateSave': True, 'secondRace': True, 'lateInspectSuppressed': True, 'accessLossCustody': True}))
except Exception:
    if driver:
        print(json.dumps({'body': driver.find_element(By.TAG_NAME, 'body').text, 'url': driver.current_url, 'requests': driver.execute_script('return window.__requests'), 'events': driver.execute_script('return window.__events'), 'beforeDoubleClick': driver.execute_script('return window.__beforeDoubleClick'), 'form': driver.execute_script('return window.__formSnapshot()'), 'logs': driver.get_log('browser')}), file=sys.stderr)
    raise
finally:
    signal.alarm(0)
    if driver: driver.quit()
